meta.title: Atlas — Professional sites for local shops across Iberia
meta.description: SiteForge kickstart: professional websites for local businesses in Portugal and Spain. Dark zinc, emerald, copper — the Optimius visual language.

hero.subtitle: AI-readable skeleton for local-shop landings. Same UI standard as Optimius Results: dark zinc, emerald, copper, Geist.

process.label: Process
process.title: How it works
process.subtitle: Three simple steps — copy this structure, swap the brand.

steps.title: Discover
steps.body: We identify your business and gather public information: address, hours, ratings, and photos.

steps.title: Generate
steps.body: AI builds a professional site in European Portuguese or Spanish, with SEO and sector-fit design.

steps.title: Launch
steps.body: Claim your site, customize it, and publish. Start free, scale when you are ready.

demo.label: Demo
demo.title: Watch your site take shape
demo.subtitle: From business name to online — interactive panel (the only card-like surface).
demo.step1Body: We look up your business, gather public data, and prepare everything automatically.
demo.step2Body: Correct local language (PT-PT or ES), optimized images, design matched to your sector.
demo.step3Title: Online in minutes, optimized for Google
demo.step3Body: Own domain, SSL, local SEO, bookings, WhatsApp. Lighthouse 98+ from the first second.

features.title: Everything your business needs
features.subtitle: Grid without cards — titles and body only, no decorative chrome.

items.title: Free to start
items.body: The basic site can stay free. No hidden fees in the product message.

items.title: SEO ready
items.body: Meta tags and schema.org from day one.

items.title: Professional design
items.body: Dark zinc, emerald, copper — the Iberia preset.

items.title: Multilingual
items.body: pt / en / es via next-intl. Change copy, not structure.

items.title: Blazing fast
items.body: Target Lighthouse 95–100. Loads in under a second.

items.title: Agent-ready
items.body: AGENTS.md + DESIGN.md explain the system to AI models.

cta.subtitle: Remix this kickstart: brand.ts → messages → deploy.
cta.note: SiteForge template. No credit card in the product message.
